newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello sees no budget impact from tax rule.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello sees no budget impact from tax rule.

text.p: Australian Federal Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday that tax collection changes in the wake of a High Court decision on state taxation were expected to have no impact on Federal or state budgets.
"There shouldn't be any impact at all," Costello told a news conference when asked if there would be any budget impact from the new taxation arrangements.
"The bottom line on this should be that the states' revenue will be the same," he said.
"The bottom line of this will be that the Commonwealth's revneue is the same and the bottom line of this must be that consumer prices will not be altered," Costello said.
